ਲਹਰਿ ਤਰੰਗ ਨਿਸੰਗ ਲਖ; ਸਾਗਰ ਸੰਗਮ ਰੰਗ ਰਵੰਦੇ ।
lehar tarang nisang lakh; saagar sangam rang ravande |
Rivers having myriad's of waves meeting the ocean becomes one with it.
ਰਤਨ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਲਖ ਲਖ; ਮੁਲਿ ਅਮੁਲਿ ਨ ਤੁਲਿ ਤੁਲੰਦੇ ।
ratan padaarath lakh lakh; mul amul na tul tulande |
In that ocean are lakhs of invaluable jewel materials, which in fact are beyond all costing.
ਸਦਕੇ, ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰਿ ਸਿਰੰਦੇ ।੯।
sadake, sirajanahaar sirande |9|
I am sacrifice unto that Creator Lord.
ਪਉੜੀ ੧੦
paurree 10
ਪਰਵਦਗਾਰੁ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ; ਸਿਰਠਿ ਉਪਾਈ ਰੰਗ ਬਿਰੰਗੀ ।
paravadagaar salaaheeai; siratth upaaee rang birangee |
That sustainer Lord ought to be praised who has created the multicoloured creation.
ਰਾਜਿਕੁ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਸਬਾਹਿਦਾ; ਸਭਨਾ ਦਾਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਅਣਮੰਗੀ ।
raajik rijak sabaahidaa; sabhanaa daat kare anamangee |
He is bestower of livelihood to everyone and giver of charity unasked for.
ਕਿਸੈ ਜਿਵੇਹਾ ਨਾਹਿ ਕੋ; ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਮੰਦੀ ਚੰਗੀ ।
kisai jivehaa naeh ko; dubidhaa andar mandee changee |
None resembles anyone and the jiva (creative) is good or bad according to the ratio of perplexity in him.
ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਨਿਰਲੇਪੁ ਹੈ; ਪੂਰਨੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਹਲੰਗੀ ।
paarabraham niralep hai; pooran braham sadaa sehalangee |
Being transcendent, He is detached from every thing and being perfect Brahm. He is always with everybody.
ਵਰਨਾਂ ਚਿਹਨਾਂ ਬਾਹਰਾ; ਸਭਨਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਹੈ ਸਰਬੰਗੀ ।
varanaan chihanaan baaharaa; sabhanaa andar hai sarabangee |
He is beyond caste and symbols etc. but side by side He pervades one and all.
ਪਉਣੁ ਪਾਣੀ, ਬੈਸੰਤਰੁ ਸੰਗੀ ।੧੦।
paun paanee, baisantar sangee |10|
He is in air, water and fire i.e. He is the power of these elements.
ਪਉੜੀ ੧੧
paurree 11
ਓਅੰਕਾਰਿ ਆਕਾਰੁ ਕਰਿ; ਮਖੀ ਇਕ ਉਪਾਈ ਮਾਇਆ ।
oankaar aakaar kar; makhee ik upaaee maaeaa |
The Oankar creating the forms created a fly named maya.
ਤਿਨਿ ਲੋਅ ਚਉਦਹ ਭਵਣੁ ਜਲ ਥਲੁ ਮਹੀਅਲੁ ਛਲੁ ਕਰਿ ਛਾਇਆ ।
tin loa chaudah bhavan jal thal maheeal chhal kar chhaaeaa |
It cheated profusely all the three worlds, fourteen abodes, water, surface and the nether world.
ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨ ਮਹੇਸੁ ਤ੍ਰੈ; ਦਸ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਬਜਾਰਿ ਨਚਾਇਆ ।
brahamaa bisan mahes trai; das avataar bajaar nachaaeaa |
All the ten incarnations, besides Brahma, Visnu, Mahesa, it made to dance in the bazar in the form of world.
ਜਤੀ ਸਤੀ ਸੰਤੋਖੀਆ; ਸਿਧ ਨਾਥ ਬਹੁ ਪੰਥ ਭਵਾਇਆ ।
jatee satee santokheea; sidh naath bahu panth bhavaaeaa |
The celibates, the chaste ones, the contented people, siddhas and naths all were made to move astray on the paths of various sects.
ਕਾਮ ਕਰੋਧ ਵਿਰੋਧ ਵਿਚਿ; ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹੁ ਕਰਿ ਧ੍ਰੋਹੁ ਲੜਾਇਆ ।
kaam karodh virodh vich; lobh mohu kar dhrohu larraaeaa |
Maya infused lust, anger, opposition, greed, infatuation, and deceit in all and made them to have infightings.
ਹਉਮੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ; ਸੇਰਹੁ ਘਟਿ ਨ ਕਿਨੈ ਅਖਾਇਆ ।
haumai andar sabh ko; serahu ghatt na kinai akhaaeaa |
Full of ego they are hollow from inside but none accepts himself imperfect (all feel they are the full measure and nothing less than it).
ਕਾਰਣੁ ਕਰਤੇ, ਆਪੁ ਲੁਕਾਇਆ ।੧੧।
kaaran karate, aap lukaaeaa |11|
The Creator Lord Himself has concealed the reason for all this.
ਪਉੜੀ ੧੨
paurree 12
ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹਾਂ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ਹੈ; ਅਬਚਲੁ ਰਾਜੁ ਵਡੀ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੀ ।
paatisaahaan paatisaahu hai; abachal raaj vaddee paatisaahee |
He (the Lord) is emperor of emperors whose rule is stable and kingdom greatly large.
ਕੇਵਡੁ ਤਖਤੁ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ; ਕੇਵਡੁ ਮਹਲੁ ਕੇਵਡੁ ਦਰਗਾਹੀ ।
kevadd takhat vakhaaneeai; kevadd mehal kevadd daragaahee |
How big are His throne, palace and the court.
ਕੇਵਡੁ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ; ਕੇਵਡੁ ਮਾਲੁ ਮੁਲਖੁ ਅਵਗਾਹੀ ।
kevadd sifat salaaheeai; kevadd maal mulakh avagaahee |
How should He be eulogised and how could be known the expanse of His treasure and territory?
ਕੇਵਡੁ ਮਾਣੁ ਮਹਤੁ ਹੈ; ਕੇਵਡੁ ਲਸਕਰ ਸੇਵ ਸਿਪਾਹੀ ।
kevadd maan mehat hai; kevadd lasakar sev sipaahee |
How great is His grandeur and magnificence and how many soldiers and armies are there in His service?
ਹੁਕਮੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਭ ਕੋ; ਕੇਵਡੁ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਬੇਪਰਵਾਹੀ ।
hukamai andar sabh ko; kevadd hukam na beparavaahee |
Everything is under His order is so much organised and powerful that no carelessness is there.
ਹੋਰਸੁ ਪੁਛਿ, ਨ ਮਤਾ ਨਿਬਾਹੀ ।੧੨।
horas puchh, na mataa nibaahee |12|
He asks none to arrange all this.
ਪਉੜੀ ੧੩
paurree 13
ਲਖ ਲਖ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੇ ਵੇਦ ਪੜ੍ਹਿ; ਇਕਸ ਅਖਰ ਭੇਦੁ ਨ ਜਾਤਾ ।
lakh lakh brahame ved parrh; ikas akhar bhed na jaataa |
Even after reading lakhs of Vedas, Brahma did not understand syllable (paramatama)
ਜੋਗ ਧਿਆਨ ਮਹੇਸ ਲਖ; ਰੂਪ ਨ ਰੇਖ ਨ ਭੇਖੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ।
jog dhiaan mahes lakh; roop na rekh na bhekh pachhaataa |
Siva meditates through lakhs of methods (postures) but still could not recognise the form, hue and guise (of the Lord).
ਲਖ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਅਕਾਰ ਕਰਿ; ਤਿਲੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ਨ ਬਿਸਨ ਪਛਾਤਾ ।
lakh avataar akaar kar; til veechaar na bisan pachhaataa |
Visnu incarnated himself through lakhs of creatures but he could not recognise even a bit of that Lord.
ਲਖ ਲਖ ਨਉਤਨ ਨਾਉ ਲੈ; ਲਖ ਲਖ ਸੇਖ ਵਿਸੇਖ ਨ ਤਾਤਾ ।
lakh lakh nautan naau lai; lakh lakh sekh visekh na taataa |
Sesanag (the mythical snake) recited and remembered many a new name of the Lord but still could not know much about Him.
ਚਿਰੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਬਹੁ ਹੰਢਣੇ; ਦਰਸਨ ਪੰਥ ਨ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਿਞਾਤਾ ।
chir jeevan bahu handtane; darasan panth na sabad siyaataa |
Many long-lived persons experienced life variously, but they all and many a philosopher could not understand Sabda, the Brahma.
ਦਾਤਿ ਲੁਭਾਇ, ਵਿਸਾਰਨਿ ਦਾਤਾ ।੧੩।
daat lubhaae, visaaran daataa |13|
All got engrossed in the gifts of that Lord and that bestower has been forgotten.
ਪਉੜੀ ੧੪
paurree 14
ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਆਕਾਰੁ ਕਰਿ; ਗੁਰ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਧਿਆਨ ਧਰਾਇਆ ।
nirankaar aakaar kar; gur moorat hoe dhiaan dharaaeaa |
The formless Lord assumed shape and getting established in the form of Guru made all to meditate upon Lord (here the hint is towards Guru Nanak).
ਚਾਰਿ ਵਰਨ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਕਰਿ; ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਚ ਖੰਡੁ ਵਸਾਇਆ ।
chaar varan gurasikh kar; saadhasangat sach khandd vasaaeaa |
He accepted disciples from all the four varnas and founded the abode of treuth in the form of holy congregation.
ਵੇਦ ਕਤੇਬਹੁ ਬਾਹਰਾ; ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ ।
ved katebahu baaharaa; akath kathaa gur sabad sunaaeaa |
He explained the grandeur of that word of the Guru beyond the Vedas and the Katebas.
ਵੀਹਾਂ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਵਰਤਮਾਨੁ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਇ ਇਕੀਹ ਲਖਾਇਆ ।
veehaan andar varatamaan; guramukh hoe ikeeh lakhaaeaa |
Those who indulged in scores of evils were now put to meditate upon the Lord.
ਮਾਇਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਉਦਾਸੁ ਕਰਿ; ਨਾਮੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਦਿੜਾਇਆ ।
maaeaa vich udaas kar; naam daan isanaan dirraaeaa |
They were kept detached amidst maya and were made to understand the importance of that holy name, charity and ablution.
ਬਾਰਹ ਪੰਥ ਇਕਤ੍ਰ ਕਰਿ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਾਡੀ ਰਾਹੁ ਚਲਾਇਆ ।
baarah panth ikatr kar; guramukh gaaddee raahu chalaaeaa |
Gathering the twelve sects together, he prepared a high path of gurmukhs.
ਪਤਿ ਪਉੜੀ ਚੜਿ, ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ।੧੪।
pat paurree charr, nij ghar aaeaa |14|
Following that path (or order) and mounting the stairs of honour they have all stabilised in their true selves.
ਪਉੜੀ ੧੫
paurree 15
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪੈਰ ਧਰਿ; ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਵਾਟ ਕੁਵਾਟ ਨ ਧਾਇਆ ।
guramukh maarag pair dhar; dubidhaa vaatt kuvaatt na dhaaeaa |
Following the path of being gurmukh man does not read on the wrong way of uncertainty.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਕੈ; ਮਰਦਾ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਨਦਰਿ ਨ ਆਇਆ ।
satigur darasan dekh kai; maradaa jaandaa nadar na aaeaa |
After beholding the true Guru, one does not see life, death, coming and going.
ਕੰਨੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਿ; ਅਨਹਦ ਰੁਣ ਝੁਣਕਾਰੁ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ ।
kanee satigur sabad sun; anahad run jhunakaar sunaaeaa |
Listening to the world of true Guru he becomes attuned to the unstruck melody.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਰਣੀ ਆਇ ਕੈ; ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ।
satigur saranee aae kai; nihachal saadhoo sang milaaeaa |
Coming to the shelter of the true Guru now man absorbs in the stabilising holy congregation.
ਚਰਣ ਕਵਲ ਮਕਰੰਦ ਰਸਿ; ਸੁਖ ਸੰਪਟ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ।
charan kaval makarand ras; sukh sanpatt vich sehaj samaaeaa |
He subsumes himself in the delight of the lotus feet.
ਪਿਰਮ ਪਿਆਲਾ, ਅਪਿਉ ਪੀਆਇਆ ।੧੫।
piram piaalaa, apiau peeaeaa |15|
Gurmukhs remain exhilarated after quaffing the hard to drink the cup of love.
ਪਉੜੀ ੧੬
paurree 16
ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਧਨਾ; ਪਿਰਮ ਪਿਆਲਾ ਅਜਰੁ ਜਰਣਾ ।
saadhasangat kar saadhanaa; piram piaalaa ajar jaranaa |
Adopting the discipline in the holy congregation, the unbearable cup of love is drunk and endured.
ਪੈਰੀ ਪੈ ਪਾ ਖਾਕੁ ਹੋਇ; ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ਜੀਵੰਦਿਆਂ ਮਰਣਾ ।
pairee pai paa khaak hoe; aap gavaae jeevandiaan maranaa |
Then the individual falling at the feet and eschewing ego dies in relation to all the worldly concerns.
ਜੀਵਣ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ; ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਡੁਬਿ ਡੁਬਿ ਤਰਣਾ ।
jeevan mukat vakhaaneeai; mar mar jeevan ddub ddub taranaa |
Liberated in life is he who dies of maya and lives up in the love of God.
ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵਲੀਣੁ ਹੋਇ; ਅਪਿਉ ਪੀਅਣੁ ਤੈ ਅਉਚਰ ਚਰਣਾ ।
sabad surat livaleen hoe; apiau peean tai aauchar charanaa |
Merging his consciousness in Word and quaffing the nectar he eats up his ego.
ਅਨਹਦ ਨਾਦ ਅਵੇਸ ਕਰਿ; ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਵਾਣੀ ਨਿਝਰੁ ਝਰਣਾ ।
anahad naad aves kar; amrit vaanee nijhar jharanaa |
Inspired by the unstruck melody he always goes on pouring the word-nectar.
ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਹੋਇ; ਕਾਰਣੁ ਕਰਣੁ ਨ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਕਰਣਾ ।
karan kaaran samarath hoe; kaaran karan na kaaran karanaa |
Now he is already cause of all the causes but still does nothing harmful to others.
ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰਣ, ਅਸਰਣ ਸਰਣਾ ।੧੬।
patit udhaaran, asaran saranaa |16|
Such a person salvages the sinners and provides shelter to the shelterless.
ਪਉੜੀ ੧੭
paurree 17
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਜੰਮਣਾ; ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਰਹਿਣਾ ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਚਲਣਾ ।
guramukh bhai vich jamanaa; bhai vich rahinaa bhai vich chalanaa |
The gurmukhs take birth in the divine will, they remain in the divine will and move in the divine will.
ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਭੈ ਭਾਇ ਵਿਚਿ; ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਕਰਿ ਅਛਲੁ ਛਲਣਾ ।
saadhasangat bhai bhaae vich; bhagat vachhal kar achhal chhalanaa |
In the discipline and love of the holy congregation they fascinate the Lord God also.
ਜਲ ਵਿਚਿ ਕਵਲੁ ਅਲਿਪਤ ਹੋਇ; ਆਸ ਨਿਰਾਸ ਵਲੇਵੈ ਵਲਣਾ ।
jal vich kaval alipat hoe; aas niraas valevai valanaa |
Being detached like lotus in the water they remain away from the cycle of hopes and disappointments.
ਅਹਰਣਿ ਘਣ ਹੀਰੇ ਜੁਗਤਿ; ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਅਟਲੁ ਨ ਟਲਣਾ ।
aharan ghan heere jugat; guramat nihachal attal na ttalanaa |
They remain steadfast like a diamond in between the hammer and the anvil and live their life deeply rooted in the wisdom of the Guru (gurmati).
ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ਵਿਚਿ; ਜੀਅ ਦੈਆ ਮੋਮ ਵਾਂਗੀ ਢਲਣਾ ।
praupakaar veechaar vich; jeea daiaa mom vaangee dtalanaa |
They always imbibe altruism in their heart and in the sphere of compassion they melt like wax.
ਚਾਰਿ ਵਰਨ ਤੰਬੋਲ ਰਸੁ; ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ਰਲਾਇਆ ਰਲਣਾ ।
chaar varan tanbol ras; aap gavaae ralaaeaa ralanaa |
As four items mix up in betel and become one, likewise the gurmukhs get adjusted with every one.
ਵਟੀ ਤੇਲੁ, ਦੀਵਾ ਹੋਇ ਬਲਣਾ ।੧੭।
vattee tel, deevaa hoe balanaa |17|
They, in the form of lamp becoming wick and oil, burn themselves (for lighting others).
ਪਉੜੀ ੧੮
paurree 18
ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਦਇਆ ਧਰਮੁ; ਅਰਥ ਕਰੋੜਿ ਨ ਓੜਕੁ ਜਾਣੈ ।
sat santokh deaa dharam; arath karorr na orrak jaanai |
Crores of properties such as truth, contentment, pity, dharma, lucre are there but none could know the extremity of that (pleasure-fruit).
ਚਾਰ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਆਖੀਅਨਿ; ਹੋਇ ਲਖੂਣਿ ਨ ਪਲੁ ਪਰਵਾਣੈ ।
chaar padaarath aakheean; hoe lakhoon na pal paravaanai |
Four ideals are said to be and may be they are multiplied by lakhs, even then they do not equal the one moment of pleasure fruit.
ਰਿਧੀ ਸਿਧੀ ਲਖ ਲਖ; ਨਿਧਿ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਲਖ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਤੁਲਾਣੈ ।
ridhee sidhee lakh lakh; nidh nidhaan lakh til na tulaanai |
Riddhis, Siddhis and lakhs of treasures do not equal its one small fraction.
ਦਰਸਨ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸੰਜੋਗ ਲਖ; ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਖ ਹੈਰਾਣੈ ।
darasan drisatt sanjog lakh; sabad surat liv lakh hairaanai |
Seeing the intimacy of Word and the consciousness, many combinations of philosophies and meditations are surprised.
ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਸਿਮਰਣ ਅਸੰਖ; ਭਗਤਿ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਲਖ ਨੇਤ ਵਖਾਣੈ ।
giaan dhiaan simaran asankh; bhagat jugat lakh net vakhaanai |
Many methods of knowledge, meditation and remembrance are put forth;
ਪਿਰਮ ਪਿਆਲਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਘਰੁ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਚੋਜ ਵਿਡਾਣੈ ।
piram piaalaa sehaj ghar; guramukh sukh fal choj viddaanai |
But reaching the tranquil stage, the pleasure-fruit of the cup of love of the Lord attained by gurmukhs is wondrous.
ਮਤਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਸੁਧਿ, ਲਖ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਣੈ ।੧੮।
mat budh sudh, lakh mel milaanai |18|
At this stage, intellect, wisdom and millions of purities get combined.
ਪਉੜੀ ੧੯
paurree 19
ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸੰਜਮ ਲਖ ਲਖ; ਹੋਮ ਜਗ ਨਈਵੇਦ ਕਰੋੜੀ ।
jap tap sanjam lakh lakh; hom jag neeved karorree |
Millions of rituals of recitation, penances, continence, burnt offerings and crores of oblations are there.
ਵਰਤ ਨੇਮ ਸੰਜਮ ਘਣੇ; ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਲਖ ਤੰਦੁ ਮਰੋੜੀ ।
varat nem sanjam ghane; karam dharam lakh tand marorree |
Fasts, rules, controls, activities are many but they all are like a weak thread.
ਤੀਰਥ ਪੁਰਬ ਸੰਜੋਗ ਲਖ; ਪੁੰਨ ਦਾਨੁ ਉਪਕਾਰ ਨ ਓੜੀ ।
teerath purab sanjog lakh; pun daan upakaar na orree |
Many are pilgrimage centres, anniversaries, and millions of virtuous acts, charities and altruism's.
ਦੇਵੀ ਦੇਵ ਸਰੇਵਣੇ; ਵਰ ਸਰਾਪ ਲਖ ਜੋੜ ਵਿਛੋੜੀ ।
devee dev sarevane; var saraap lakh jorr vichhorree |
Millions kinds of worship of gods and goddesses, combinations, detractions, boons, curses are there.
ਦਰਸਨ ਵਰਨ ਅਵਰਨ ਲਖ; ਪੂਜਾ ਅਰਚਾ ਬੰਧਨ ਤੋੜੀ ।
darasan varan avaran lakh; poojaa arachaa bandhan torree |
Many philosophies, varnas, non-varnas and many are the persons who do not bother about the (unnecessary) brands of lakhs of worships and oblations.
ਲੋਕ ਵੇਦ ਗੁਣ ਗਿਆਨ ਲਖ; ਜੋਗ ਭੋਗ ਲਖ ਝਾੜਿ ਪਛੋੜੀ ।
lok ved gun giaan lakh; jog bhog lakh jhaarr pachhorree |
Many are the means of public behaviour, virtues, renunciation, indulgence and other covering devices;
ਸਚਹੁ ਓਰੈ ਸਭ ਕਿਹੁ; ਲਖ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਸੱਭਾ ਥੋੜੀ ।
sachahu orai sabh kihu; lakh siaanap sabhaa thorree |
But all these are craftsmanship's remain away from the truth; they cannot touch it.
ਉਪਰਿ ਸਚੁ, ਅਚਾਰੁ ਚਮੋੜੀ ।੧੯।
aupar sach, achaar chamorree |19|
Higher than truth is truthful living.
ਪਉੜੀ ੨੦
paurree 20
ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਚਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ; ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਚੁ ਤਖਤੁ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ।
satigur sachaa paatisaahu; saadhasangat sach takhat suhelaa |
The true Guru (God) is the true emperor and the holy congregation is true throne which is most delightful.
ਸਚੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਟਕਸਾਲ ਸਚੁ; ਅਸਟ ਧਾਤੁ ਇਕ ਪਾਰਸ ਮੇਲਾ ।
sach sabad ttakasaal sach; asatt dhaat ik paaras melaa |
The true Word is such a true mint where different castes in the from of metals meet the Guru, the philosopher's stone, and become gold (gurmukhs).
ਸਚਾ ਅਬਿਚਲ ਰਾਜ ਹੈ; ਸਚ ਮਹਲ ਨਵਹਾਣ ਨਵੇਲਾ ।
sachaa abichal raaj hai; sach mehal navahaan navelaa |
There, only the true divine Will operates because the order of truth alone is bestower of joy and delight.
ਸਚਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ; ਸਚਾ ਅਮਰੁ ਸਚੋ ਰਸ ਕੇਲਾ ।
sachaa hukam varatadaa; sachaa amar sacho ras kelaa |
There, only the true divine Will operates because the order of truth alone is bestower of joy and delight.
ਸਚੀ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਲਾਹ ਸਚੁ; ਸਚੁ ਸਲਾਹਣੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਵੇਲਾ ।
sachee sifat salaah sach; sach salaahan amrit velaa |
There, in the early morning eulogisation is true and is of the truth alone.
ਸਚਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੰਥੁ ਹੈ; ਸਚੁ ਉਪਦੇਸ ਨ ਗਰਬਿ ਗਹੇਲਾ ।
sachaa guramukh panth hai; sach upades na garab gahelaa |
ਆਸਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਨਿਰਾਸ ਗਤਿ; ਸਚਾ ਖੇਲੁ ਮੇਲੁ ਸਚੁ ਖੇਲਾ ।
aasaa vich niraas gat; sachaa khel mel sach khelaa |
Gurmukhs remain detached among many hopes and they always play the game of truth.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਿਖੁ ਗੁਰੂ, ਗੁਰ ਚੇਲਾ ।੨੦।
guramukh sikh guroo, gur chelaa |20|
Such gurmukhs become Guru and the Guru becomes their disciple.
ਪਉੜੀ ੨੧
paurree 21
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਪਰਹਰੈ; ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਖਸਮੈ ਦਾ ਭਾਣਾ ।
guramukh haumai paraharai; man bhaavai khasamai daa bhaanaa |
Gurmukh repudiates ego and he likes the will of God.
ਪੈਰੀ ਪੈ ਪਾ ਖਾਕ ਹੋਇ; ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਵੈ ਮਾਣੁ ਨਿਮਾਣਾ ।
pairee pai paa khaak hoe; daragah paavai maan nimaanaa |
Becoming humble and falling at the feet he becomes dust and earns honour in the court of the Lord.
ਵਰਤਮਾਨ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ; ਹੋਵਣਹਾਰ ਸੋਈ ਪਰਵਾਣਾ ।
varatamaan vich varatadaa; hovanahaar soee paravaanaa |
He always moves in the present i.e. never ignores the contemporary situations and side by side accepts whatever is likely to happen.
ਕਾਰਣੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਜੋ ਕਰੈ; ਸਿਰਿ ਧਰਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਕਰੈ ਸੁਕਰਾਣਾ ।
kaaran karataa jo karai; sir dhar man karai sukaraanaa |
Whatever is done by the creator of all the causes, is gratefully accepted by him.
ਰਾਜੀ ਹੋਇ ਰਜਾਇ ਵਿਚਿ; ਦੁਨੀਆਂ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਜਿਉ ਮਿਹਮਾਣਾ ।
raajee hoe rajaae vich; duneean andar jiau mihamaanaa |
He remains happy in the will of the Lord and considers himself a guest in the world.
ਵਿਸਮਾਦੀ ਵਿਸਮਾਦ ਵਿਚਿ; ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕਾਦਰ ਨੋ ਕੁਰਬਾਣਾ ।
visamaadee visamaad vich; kudarat kaadar no kurabaanaa |
He remains elated in the love of the Lord and goes sacrificed unto the feats of the creator.
ਲੇਪ ਅਲੇਪ, ਸਦਾ ਨਿਰਬਾਣਾ ।੨੧।
lep alep, sadaa nirabaanaa |21|
Living in the world he remains detached and liberated.
ਪਉੜੀ ੨੨
paurree 22
ਹੁਕਮੀ ਬੰਦਾ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ; ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਦੇ ਹੁਕਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਰਹਣਾ ।
hukamee bandaa hoe kai; saahib de hukamai vich rahanaa |
One should remain in the will of the Lord by becoming an obedient servant.
ਹੁਕਮੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਭ ਕੋ; ਸਭਨਾ ਆਵਟਣ ਹੈ ਸਹਣਾ ।
hukamai andar sabh ko; sabhanaa aavattan hai sahanaa |
All are in His will and all have to bear the heat of the divine order.
ਦਿਲੁ ਦਰੀਆਉ ਸਮਾਉ ਕਰਿ; ਗਰਬੁ ਗਵਾਇ ਗਰੀਬੀ ਵਹਣਾ ।
dil dareeaau samaau kar; garab gavaae gareebee vahanaa |
Man should make his heart a river and let the water of humility flow into it.
ਵੀਹ ਇਕੀਹ ਉਲੰਘਿ ਕੈ; ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਿੰਘਾਸਣਿ ਬਹਣਾ ।
veeh ikeeh ulangh kai; saadhasangat singhaasan bahanaa |
Leaving the worldly activities one should sit on the throne of holy congregation.
ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵਲੀਣੁ ਹੋਇ; ਅਨਭਉ ਅਘੜ ਘੜਾਏ ਗਹਣਾ ।
sabad surat livaleen hoe; anbhau agharr gharraae gahanaa |
Merging consciousness in the Word, one should get the ornament of fearlessness prepared.
ਸਿਦਕ ਸਬੂਰੀ ਸਾਬਤਾ; ਸਾਕਰੁ ਸੁਕਰਿ ਨ ਦੇਣਾ ਲਹਣਾ ।
sidak sabooree saabataa; saakar sukar na denaa lahanaa |
One should remain true in faith and contentment; the transaction of thankfulness should be kept to continue and one should remain away from worldly give and take.
ਨੀਰਿ ਨ ਡੁਬਣੁ, ਅਗਿ ਨ ਦਹਣਾ ।੨੨।
neer na dduban, ag na dahanaa |22|
Such a person neither drowns in water (of maya) nor gets burnt in the fire (of desire).
ਪਉੜੀ ੨੩
paurree 23
ਮਿਹਰ ਮੁਹਬਤਿ ਆਸਕੀ; ਇਸਕੁ ਮੁਸਕੁ ਕਿਉ ਲੁਕੈ ਲੁਕਾਇਆ ।
mihar muhabat aasakee; isak musak kiau lukai lukaaeaa |
Kindness, affection, passionate love and smell do not remain concealed even if they are hidden and of their own get manifested.
ਚੰਦਨ ਵਾਸੁ ਵਣਾਸਪਤਿ; ਹੋਇ ਸੁਗੰਧੁ ਨ ਆਪੁ ਗਣਾਇਆ ।
chandan vaas vanaasapat; hoe sugandh na aap ganaaeaa |
Sandal makes the whole vegetation fragrant and never makes it self noticed (but still people come to know that).
ਨਦੀਆਂ ਨਾਲੇ ਗੰਗ ਮਿਲਿ; ਹੋਇ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਨ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ ।
nadeean naale gang mil; hoe pavit na aakh sunaaeaa |
Rivers and streams meet the Ganges and silently become pure without any announcement.
ਹੀਰੇ ਹੀਰਾ ਬੇਧਿਆ; ਅਣੀ ਕਣੀ ਹੋਇ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਮਾਇਆ ।
heere heeraa bedhiaa; anee kanee hoe ridai samaaeaa |

The diamond is cut by the diamond and the cutter diamond looks as if it has adopted the other diamond in its heart (likewise the Guru also cutting the mind of disciple gives place to him in his own heart).
ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧ ਹੋਇ; ਪਾਰਸ ਮਿਲਿ ਪਾਰਸ ਹੋਇ ਆਇਆ ।
saadhasangat mil saadh hoe; paaras mil paaras hoe aaeaa |
The disciple of the Guru becomes such a sadhu in the holy congregation as if someone becomes philosopher's stone after touching the philosopher's stone.
ਨਿਹਚਉ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ; ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਅਛਲੁ ਛਲਾਇਆ ।
nihchau nihachal guramatee; bhagat vachhal hoe achhal chhalaaeaa |
With the steadfast teaching of the Guru, the mind of the Sikh becomes peaceful and God also becoming affectionate towards the devotee gets deluded.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ, ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਆ ।੨੩।੧੮। ਅਠਾਰਾਂ ।
guramukh sukh fal, alakh lakhaaeaa |23|18| atthaaraan |
Getting a sight of the imperceptible Lord is the pleasure-fruit for the gurmukhs.
ਪਉੜੀ ੧
paurree 1
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਏਕੰਕਾਰ, ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਇਆ ।
guramukh ekankaar, aap upaaeaa |
Ekankar, the Lors second to none, created gurmukh (to liberate the world).
ਓਅੰਕਾਰਿ ਅਕਾਰੁ, ਪਰਗਟੀ ਆਇਆ ।
oankaar akaar, paragattee aaeaa |
That Oankar assuming forms has become manifest.
ਪੰਚ ਤਤ ਵਿਸਤਾਰੁ, ਚਲਤੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ।
panch tat visataar, chalat rachaaeaa |
By extension (and combination) of the five elements this world has been created.
ਖਾਣੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਚਾਰਿ, ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ।
khaanee baanee chaar, jagat upaaeaa |
The four mines of life and four speeches ( para, pasyanti, madhyama, vaikhari) have been generated.
ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰੁ, ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ।
kudarat agam apaar, ant na paaeaa |
His feats of amusements are inaccessible and limitless; their extremes are unattainable.
ਸਚੁ ਨਾਉ ਕਰਤਾਰ, ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ।੧।
sach naau karataar, sach samaaeaa |1|
The name of that creator is Truth and He is ever immersed in Truth.
ਪਉੜੀ ੨
paurree 2
ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਜੂਨਿ, ਫੇਰਿ ਫਿਰਾਇਆ ।
lakh chauraaseeh joon, fer firaaeaa |
Souls wander fruitlessly in the eighty-four lakhs of species of life.
ਮਾਣਸ ਜਨਮੁ ਦੁਲੰਭੁ, ਕਰਮੀ ਪਾਇਆ ।
maanas janam dulanbh, karamee paaeaa |
The rare human body has been obtained owing to virtuous actions.
ਉਤਮੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੰਥੁ, ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ।
autam guramukh panth, aap gavaaeaa |
Moving on greatest path of the Guru orientated, the self has lost the ego.
ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਰਹਰਾਸਿ, ਪੈਰੀਂ ਪਾਇਆ ।
saadhasangat raharaas, paireen paaeaa |
Maintaining the discipline of the holy congregation has come to fall at the feet (of the Guru).
ਨਾਮੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ, ਸਚੁ ਦਿੜਾਇਆ ।
naam daan isanaan, sach dirraaeaa |
Gurmukhs have adopted the name of the Lord, the charity, the ablution and truthful conduct steadfastly.
ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਲੀਣੁ, ਭਾਣਾ ਭਾਇਆ ।੨।
sabad surat liv leen, bhaanaa bhaaeaa |2|
The man has merged his consciousness in the Word and has accepted the will of the Lord.
ਪਉੜੀ ੩
paurree 3
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਘੜੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ, ਗੁਰ ਸਮਝਾਇਆ ।
guramukh sugharr sujaan, gur samajhaaeaa |
Gurmukh taught by the Guru is well trained and knowledgeable.
ਮਿਹਮਾਣੀ ਮਿਹਮਾਣੁ, ਮਜਲਸਿ ਆਇਆ ।
mihamaanee mihamaan, majalas aaeaa |
He understands that he has come to the assembly of this world as a guest.
ਖਾਵਾਲੇ ਸੋ ਖਾਣੁ, ਪੀਐ ਪੀਆਇਆ ।
khaavaale so khaan, peeai peeaeaa |
He eats and drinks what is bestowed by the Lord.
ਕਰੈ ਨ ਗਰਬੁ ਗੁਮਾਣੁ, ਹਸੈ ਹਸਾਇਆ ।
karai na garab gumaan, hasai hasaaeaa |
Gurmukh is not arrogant and feels happy in the happiness given by the Lord.
ਪਾਹੁਨੜਾ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ, ਕਾਜੁ ਸੁਹਾਇਆ ।
paahunarraa paravaan, kaaj suhaaeaa |
Only that guest gets accepted in the court of the Lord who has lived here as a good guest.
ਮਜਲਸ ਕਰਿ ਹੈਰਾਣੁ, ਉਠਿ ਸਿਧਾਇਆ ।੩।
majalas kar hairaan, utth sidhaaeaa |3|
He moves from here silently and makes the whole assembly wonders struck (because others feel very difficult to leave this world).
ਪਉੜੀ ੪
paurree 4
ਗੋਇਲੜਾ ਦਿਨ ਚਾਰਿ, ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਣੀਐ ।
goeilarraa din chaar, guramukh jaaneeai |
Gurmukh knows this world as a place of rest for a few days.
ਮੰਝੀ ਲੈ ਮਿਹਵਾਰਿ, ਚੋਜ ਵਿਡਾਣੀਐ ।
manjhee lai mihavaar, choj viddaaneeai |
Here with the help of wealth many types of sports and feats are enacted.
ਵਰਸੈ ਨਿਝਰ ਧਾਰਿ, ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਵਾਣੀਐ ।
varasai nijhar dhaar, amrit vaaneeai |
In this very world, for gurmukhs incessant rain of nectar goes on pouring.
ਵੰਝੁਲੀਐ ਝੀਗਾਰਿ, ਮਜਲਸਿ ਮਾਣੀਐ ।
vanjhuleeai jheegaar, majalas maaneeai |
On the tune of flute (the unstruck melody) they go on enjoying the delight of the assembly.
ਗਾਵਣਿ ਮਾਝ ਮਲਾਰਿ, ਸੁਘੜੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੀਐ ।
gaavan maajh malaar, sugharr sujaaneeai |
Well-trained and knowledgeable persons sing Majh and Malhar musical measures here i.e. they enjoy the present.
ਹਉਮੈ ਗਰਬੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ, ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿ ਆਣੀਐ ।
haumai garab nivaar, man vas aaneeai |
They lose their ego and control their minds.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ, ਸਚਿ ਸਿਞਾਣੀਐ ।੪।
guramukh sabad veechaar, sach siyaaneeai |4|
Contemplating the Word, the Gurmukh identifies the truth.
ਪਉੜੀ ੫
paurree 5
ਵਾਟ ਵਟਾਊ ਰਾਤਿ, ਸਰਾਈਂ ਵਸਿਆ ।
vaatt vattaaoo raat, saraaeen vasiaa |
A wayfarer, on the way halted in an inn.
ਉਠ ਚਲਿਆ ਪਰਭਾਤਿ, ਮਾਰਗਿ ਦਸਿਆ ।
autth chaliaa parabhaat, maarag dasiaa |
Then moved forward on the told path.
ਨਾਹਿ ਪਰਾਈ ਤਾਤਿ, ਨ ਚਿਤਿ ਰਹਸਿਆ ।
naeh paraaee taat, na chit rahasiaa |
He neither got envious with anyone nor did he get infatuated by any.
ਮੁਏ ਨ ਪੁਛੈ ਜਾਤਿ, ਵਿਵਾਹਿ ਨ ਹਸਿਆ ।
mue na puchhai jaat, vivaeh na hasiaa |
He neither asked the caste (identity) of any dying person nor he felt any delight witnessing the marriage ceremonies etc.
ਦਾਤਾ ਕਰੇ ਜੁ ਦਾਤਿ, ਨ ਭੁਖਾ ਤਸਿਆ ।
daataa kare ju daat, na bhukhaa tasiaa |
He happily accepted gifts of the Lord and never remained hungry or thirsty.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਿਮਰਣੁ ਵਾਤਿ, ਕਵਲੁ ਵਿਗਸਿਆ ।੫।
guramukh simaran vaat, kaval vigasiaa |5|
The lotus face of the gurmukh always remains in blossom due to continuous remembrance of the Lord.
ਪਉੜੀ ੬
paurree 6
ਦੀਵਾਲੀ ਦੀ ਰਾਤਿ, ਦੀਵੇ ਬਾਲੀਅਨਿ ।
deevaalee dee raat, deeve baaleean |
Lamps are lighted in the night of divali festival;
ਤਾਰੇ ਜਾਤਿ ਸਨਾਤਿ, ਅੰਬਰਿ ਭਾਲੀਅਨਿ ।
taare jaat sanaat, anbar bhaaleean |
Stars of different variety appear in the sky;
ਫੁਲਾਂ ਦੀ ਬਾਗਾਤਿ, ਚੁਣਿ ਚੁਣਿ ਚਾਲੀਅਨਿ ।
fulaan dee baagaat, chun chun chaaleean |
In the gardens the flowers are there which are selectively plucked;
ਤੀਰਥਿ ਜਾਤੀ ਜਾਤਿ, ਨੈਣ ਨਿਹਾਲੀਅਨਿ ।
teerath jaatee jaat, nain nihaaleean |
The pilgrims going to pilgrimage centres are also seen.
ਹਰਿ ਚੰਦਉਰੀ ਝਾਤਿ, ਵਸਾਇ ਉਚਾਲੀਅਨਿ ।
har chandauree jhaat, vasaae uchaaleean |
The imaginary habitats have been seen coming into being and vanishing.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਦਾਤਿ, ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮ੍ਹਾਲੀਅਨਿ ।੬।
guramukh sukh fal daat, sabad samhaaleean |6|
All these are momentary, but the gurmukhs with the help of the Word nourish the gift of the pleasure fruit.
ਪਉੜੀ ੭
paurree 7
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਨਿ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ, ਗੁਰਿ ਉਪਦੇਸਿਆ ।
guramukh man paragaas, gur upadesiaa |
The gurmukh who have received well with the Guru's teachings have got their minds enlightened.
ਪੇਈਅੜੈ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ, ਮਿਟੈ ਅੰਦੇਸਿਆ ।
peeearrai ghar vaas, mittai andesiaa |
They have understood that the world is like a parental home; one has to go one day from here and hence all their doubts have been removed.
ਆਸਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਨਿਰਾਸੁ, ਗਿਆਨੁ ਅਵੇਸਿਆ ।
aasaa vich niraas, giaan avesiaa |
They are unattached amid hopes and remain charged with the knowledge.
ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਰਹਰਾਸਿ, ਸਬਦਿ ਸੰਦੇਸਿਆ ।
saadhasangat raharaas, sabad sandesiaa |
They spread message of the Word in accordance with the conduct of the holy congregation.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸ, ਮਤਿ ਪਰਵੇਸਿਆ ।
guramukh daasan daas, mat paravesiaa |
The idea that they are servants of the servants of the Lord has got deeply rooted in the wisdom of the gurmukhs.
ਸਿਮਰਣ ਸਾਸਿ ਗਿਰਾਸਿ, ਦੇਸ ਵਿਦੇਸਿਆ ।੭।
simaran saas giraas, des videsiaa |7|
Be they anywhere in the country or abroad they remember God with every inhalation and exhalation of breath.
ਪਉੜੀ ੮
paurree 8
ਨਦੀ ਨਾਵ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ, ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ।
nadee naav sanjog, mel milaaeaa |
As in a boat per-chance many persons unknown to each other meet, likewise the creatures in the world meet each other.
ਸੁਹਣੇ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਭੋਗੁ, ਰਾਜੁ ਕਮਾਇਆ ।
suhane andar bhog, raaj kamaaeaa |
The world is such as if ruling a kingdom and enjoying the pleasures in a dream.
ਕਦੇ ਹਰਖੁ ਕਦੇ ਸੋਗੁ, ਤਰਵਰ ਛਾਇਆ ।
kade harakh kade sog, taravar chhaaeaa |
Here happiness and sufferings are like shade of the tree.
ਕਟੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ, ਨ ਆਪੁ ਗਣਾਇਆ ।
kattai haumai rog, na aap ganaaeaa |
Here in fact he has decimated the malady of ego who has not made himself to be noticed.
ਘਰ ਹੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਜੋਗੁ, ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ।
ghar hee andar jog, guramukh paaeaa |
Becoming gurmukh, individual even being at one's home attains union (with the Lord).
ਹੋਵਣਹਾਰ ਸੁ ਹੋਗੁ, ਗੁਰ ਸਮਝਾਇਆ ।੮।
hovanahaar su hog, gur samajhaaeaa |8|
The Guru has made him understand that destiny cannot be averted (hence one without being worried should go on doing one's works).
ਪਉੜੀ ੯
paurree 9
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗੁ, ਚਲਣੁ ਜਾਣਿਆ ।
guramukh saadhoo sang, chalan jaaniaa |
Gurmukhs have learnt the technique of life in the holy congregation.
ਚੇਤਿ ਬਸੰਤ ਸੁਰੰਗੁ, ਸਭ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਣਿਆ ।
chet basant surang, sabh rang maaniaa |
They have consciously enjoyed the delight of the spring season of life.
ਸਾਵਣ ਲਹਰਿ ਤਰੰਗ, ਨੀਰੁ ਨੀਵਾਣਿਆ ।
saavan lehar tarang, neer neevaaniaa |
They are elated like the water of rainy season (Savan) but still they (gurmukhs) have made water of hopes and desires go down and downward.
ਸਜਣ ਮੇਲੁ ਸੁ ਢੰਗ, ਚੋਜ ਵਿਡਾਣਿਆ ।
sajan mel su dtang, choj viddaaniaa |
Meeting with such persons is wonderfully delightful.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੰਥੁ ਨਿਪੰਗੁ, ਦਰਿ ਪਰਵਾਣਿਆ ।
guramukh panth nipang, dar paravaaniaa |
They way of gurmukhs is devoid of mire and is accepted in the court of the Lord.
ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮੇਲੁ ਅਭੰਗੁ, ਸਤਿ ਸੁਹਾਣਿਆ ।੯।
guramat mel abhang, sat suhaaniaa |9|
A meeting through the wisdom of the Guru is obstruction free, true and delightful.
ਪਉੜੀ ੧੦
paurree 10
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਫਲ ਜਨੰਮੁ, ਜਗਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਆਇਆ ।
guramukh safal janam, jag vich aaeaa |
Blest is the birth of a gurmukh and his coming to this world.
ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਪੂਰ ਕਰੰਮ, ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ।
guramat poor karam, aap gavaaeaa |
In accordance with the wisdom of the Guru he deletes his ego and accomplishes the (virtuous) actions.
ਭਾਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਕੰਮੁ, ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ।
bhaau bhagat kar kam, sukh fal paaeaa |
He works controlled by his love for work and loving devotion, and receives the pleasure fruit (of life).
ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਅਗੰਮੁ, ਰਿਦੈ ਵਸਾਇਆ ।
gur upades agam, ridai vasaaeaa |
The inaccessible teachings of the Guru he adopts in his heart.
ਧੀਰਜੁ ਧੁਜਾ ਧਰੰਮੁ, ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇਆ ।
dheeraj dhujaa dharam, sehaj subhaaeaa |
Keeping of the flag of forbearance and dharma high, becomes his innate nature.
ਸਹੈ ਨ ਦੂਖ ਸਹੰਮੁ, ਭਾਣਾ ਭਾਇਆ ।੧੦।
sahai na dookh saham, bhaanaa bhaaeaa |10|
He bows before the will of the Lord and never suffers any fear or sorrow.
ਪਉੜੀ ੧੧
paurree 11
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦੁਰਲਭ ਦੇਹ, ਅਉਸਰੁ ਜਾਣਦੇ ।
guramukh duralabh deh, aausar jaanade |
Gurmukhs know (very well) that human birth is a rare opportunity.
ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਅਸਨੇਹ, ਸਭ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਣਦੇ ।
saadhasangat asaneh, sabh rang maanade |
That is why they cultivate love for holy congregation and enjoy all delights.
ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵਲੇਹ, ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣਦੇ ।
sabad surat livaleh, aakh vakhaanade |
They speak after merging their consciousness in the Word.
ਦੇਹੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਬਿਦੇਹ, ਸਚੁ ਸਿਞਾਣਦੇ ।
dehee vich bideh, sach siyaanade |
They become bodiless while living in body and identify the truth.
ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਓਹੁ ਨ ਏਹੁ, ਇਕੁ ਪਛਾਣਦੇ ।
dubidhaa ohu na ehu, ik pachhaanade |
They do not have this or that dilemma and know only one Lord.
ਚਾਰਿ ਦਿਹਾੜੇ ਥੇਹੁ, ਮਨ ਵਿਚਿ ਆਣਦੇ ।੧੧।
chaar dihaarre thehu, man vich aanade |11|
They know in their heart of heart that within a short period this world is going to become a mound (of earth) and hence they do not develop any attachment with it.
ਪਉੜੀ ੧੨
paurree 12
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰੀ, ਵਿਰਲਾ ਆਇਆ ।
guramukh praupakaaree, viralaa aaeaa |
Rarely comes a benevolent gurmukh who serves others.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇ, ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ।
guramukh sukh fal paae, aap gavaaeaa |
The Gurmukh abandons ego and receives the fruit of delight.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਖੀ ਸਬਦਿ, ਸਿਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ ।
guramukh saakhee sabad, sikh sunaaeaa |
Only the gurmukh tells the story of the (grandeur of ) Word to the disciples (of the Guru) and never claims to tell something as his own.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ, ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਇਆ ।
guramukh sabad veechaar, sach kamaaeaa |
Deeply pondering over the Word, a gurmukh practices truth in his life,
ਸਚੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਮੁਹਿ ਸਚੁ, ਸਚਿ ਸੁਹਾਇਆ ।
sach ridai muhi sach, sach suhaaeaa |
He likes the truth, which resides in his heart as well as speech.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਵਾਰਿ, ਜਗਤੁ ਤਰਾਇਆ ।੧੨।
guramukh janam savaar, jagat taraaeaa |12|
Such a gurmukh not only spruces his own life he rather gets the whole world across.
ਪਉੜੀ ੧੩
paurree 13
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ, ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ।
guramukh aap gavaae, aap pachhaaniaa |
The Gurmukh losing his ego and identifies his self.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਤਿ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ, ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਣਿਆ ।
guramukh sat santokh, sehaj samaaniaa |
The Gurmukh enters his innate nature through truth and contentment.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਧੀਰਜੁ ਧਰਮੁ, ਦਇਆ ਸੁਖੁ ਮਾਣਿਆ ।
guramukh dheeraj dharam, deaa sukh maaniaa |
The Gurmukh alone enjoys the true delights of forbearance, dharma and compassion.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਰਥੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ, ਸਬਦੁ ਵਖਾਣਿਆ ।
guramukh arath veechaar, sabad vakhaaniaa |
Gurmukhs very well understand the importance of the words first, and only then they speak them out.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਂਦੇ ਤਾਣ, ਰਹੈ ਨਿਤਾਣਿਆ ।
guramukh honde taan, rahai nitaaniaa |
Though being powerful, the gurmukhs always consider themselves weak and humble.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਾਣੁ, ਹੋਇ ਨਿਮਾਣਿਆ ।੧੩।
guramukh daragah maan, hoe nimaaniaa |13|
Because the gurmukhs are polite, they receive respects in the court of the Lord.
ਪਉੜੀ ੧੪
paurree 14
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਵਾਰਿ, ਦਰਗਹ ਚਲਿਆ ।
guramukh janam savaar, daragah chaliaa |
Spending this life fruitfully gurmukh goes to the other world.
ਸਚੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਜਾਇ, ਸਚਾ ਪਿੜੁ ਮਲਿਆ ।
sachee daragah jaae, sachaa pirr maliaa |
There in the true court (of lord) he gets his true place.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਭਾਉ, ਚਾਉ ਅਲਲਿਆ ।
guramukh bhojan bhaau, chaau alaliaa |
Repast of gurmukh is love and his delight is devoid of flirtatiousness.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਚਿਤੁ, ਨ ਹਲੈ ਹਲਿਆ ।
guramukh nihachal chit, na halai haliaa |
Gurmukh has a tranquil heart and remains steadfast even in ups and downs.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੁ ਅਲਾਉ, ਭਲੀ ਹੂੰ ਭਲਿਆ ।
guramukh sach alaau, bhalee hoon bhaliaa |
He speaks truth and good of the good.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦੇ ਜਾਨਿ, ਆਵਨਿ ਘਲਿਆ ।੧੪।
guramukh sade jaan, aavan ghaliaa |14|
Only gurmukhs are called to the court of the Lord and they come to the world only when the Lord sends them.
ਪਉੜੀ ੧੫
paurree 15
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਧਿ ਅਸਾਧੁ, ਸਾਧੁ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ ।
guramukh saadh asaadh, saadh vakhaaneeai |
Gurmukh accomplishes the intractable and hence is called sadhu.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਬਿਬੇਕ, ਬਿਬੇਕੀ ਜਾਣੀਐ ।
guramukh budh bibek, bibekee jaaneeai |
Gurmukh has such wisdom, which is competent to separate water from milk. This is why he is called wise.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਾਉ ਭਗਤਿ, ਭਗਤੁ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ।
guramukh bhaau bhagat, bhagat pachhaaneeai |
The devotion of gurmukh is loving devotion.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੁ, ਗਿਆਨੀ ਬਾਣੀਐ ।
guramukh braham giaan, giaanee baaneeai |
Since the gurmukhs attain divine knowledge, they are called knowledgeable ones (jnanis).
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੂਰਣ ਮਤਿ, ਸਬਦਿ ਨੀਸਾਣੀਐ ।
guramukh pooran mat, sabad neesaaneeai |
Gurmukhs have the wisdom fully stamped and marked by the Word.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਉੜੀ ਪਤਿ, ਪਿਰਮ ਰਸੁ ਮਾਣੀਐ ।੧੫।
guramukh paurree pat, piram ras maaneeai |15|
Climbing the stairs of high regards, the gurmukh enjoys the delight of love of the beloved Lord.
ਪਉੜੀ ੧੬
paurree 16
ਸਚੁ ਨਾਉ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ, ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਈਐ ।
sach naau karataar, guramukh paaeeai |
The true name of the creator Lord is received from the gurmukhs,
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਓਅੰਕਾਰ, ਸਬਦਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ।
guramukh oankaar, sabad dhiaaeeai |
Amidst the gurmukhs the Oankar Word is remembered.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ, ਸਦਾ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈਐ ।
guramukh sabad veechaar, sadaa liv laaeeai |
Amid the gurmukhs the word is pondered upon and the consciousness is merged in it,
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੁ ਅਚਾਰੁ, ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਈਐ ।
guramukh sach achaar, sach kamaaeeai |
Living the truthful life of the gurmukhs, the truth is accomplished in life.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ, ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਈਐ ।
guramukh mokh duaar, sehaj samaaeeai |
Gurmukh is that door of liberation through which one automatically enters his innate nature (the divine self).
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ, ਨ ਪਛੋਤਾਈਐ ।੧੬।
guramukh naam adhaar, na pachhotaaeeai |16|
He base of name (of the Lord) is attained from gurmukhs and one does not repent in the end.
ਪਉੜੀ ੧੭
paurree 17
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਰਸੁ ਪਰਸਿ, ਪਾਰਸੁ ਹੋਈਐ ।
guramukh paaras paras, paaras hoeeai |
Touching the philosopher's stone in the form of a gurmukh one himself becomes the philosophers stone.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਇ ਅਪਰਸੁ, ਦਰਸੁ ਅਲੋਈਐ ।
guramukh hoe aparas, daras aloeeai |
By the glimpse only of the gurmukh, all evil passions become untouchable.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਧਿਆਨੁ, ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਖੋਈਐ ।
guramukh braham dhiaan, dubidhaa khoeeai |
Meditating upon the Lord amid the gurmukhs one loses duality.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਰ ਧਨ ਰੂਪ, ਨਿੰਦ ਨ ਗੋਈਐ ।
guramukh par dhan roop, nind na goeeai |
In the company of the gurmukhs neither the wealth and physical beauty of others is seen nor is backbiting committed.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਉ, ਸਬਦੁ ਵਿਲੋਈਐ ।
guramukh amrit naau, sabad viloeeai |
In the company of gurmukhs only nectar-name in the form of Word is churned and the essence is acquired.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਸਦਾ ਜਾਇ, ਅੰਤ ਨ ਰੋਈਐ ।੧੭।
guramukh hasadaa jaae, ant na roeeai |17|
In the company of gurmukhs the jiva (self) at last becomes happy and does not wail and weep.
ਪਉੜੀ ੧੮
paurree 18
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਹੋਇ, ਜਗੁ ਪਰਬੋਧੀਐ ।
guramukh panddit hoe, jag parabodheeai |
As a knowledgeable person, the gurmukh imparts knowledge to the world.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ, ਅੰਦਰੁ ਸੋਧੀਐ ।
guramukh aap gavaae, andar sodheeai |
Losing their ego, the gurmukhs purify their inner-self.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ, ਨ ਕਾਮੁ ਕਰੋਧੀਐ ।
guramukh sat santokh, na kaam karodheeai |
Gurmukhs adopt truth and contentment and do not indulge in lust and anger.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੈ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ, ਨ ਵੈਰ ਵਿਰੋਧੀਐ ।
guramukh hai niravair, na vair virodheeai |
Gurmukhs have no enmity and opposition towards anyone.
ਚਹੁ ਵਰਨਾ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ, ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮੋਧੀਐ ।
chahu varanaa upades, sehaj samodheeai |
Preaching to all the four varnas, gurmukhs merge in equipoise.
ਧੰਨੁ ਜਣੇਦੀ ਮਾਉ, ਜੋਧਾ ਜੋਧੀਐ ।੧੮।
dhan janedee maau, jodhaa jodheeai |18|
Blest is the mother of a gurmukh who has given birth to him and the gurmukh is the best among warriors.
ਪਉੜੀ ੧੯
paurree 19
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵਾਹੁ, ਸਬਦਿ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ ।
guramukh satigur vaahu, sabad salaaheeai |
Gurmukh eulogises the wondrous Lord in the form.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਲਾਹ, ਸਚੀ ਪਤਿਸਾਹੀਐ ।
guramukh sifat salaah, sachee patisaaheeai |
Gurmukhs have true kingdom of God's praises.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੁ ਸਨਾਹੁ, ਦਾਦਿ ਇਲਾਹੀਐ ।
guramukh sach sanaahu, daad ilaaheeai |
Gurmukhs have armour of truth which they have been gifted by the Lord.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਾਡੀ ਰਾਹੁ, ਸਚੁ ਨਿਬਾਹੀਐ ।
guramukh gaaddee raahu, sach nibaaheeai |
For gurmukhs only the beautiful highway of truth has been prepared.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਤਿ ਅਗਾਹੁ, ਗਾਹਣਿ ਗਾਹੀਐ ।
guramukh mat agaahu, gaahan gaaheeai |
Their wisdom is unfathomable and to get to it one gets perplexed.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ, ਨ ਬੇਪਰਵਾਹੀਐ ।੧੯।
guramukh beparavaahu, na beparavaaheeai |19|
Gurmukh is carefree in the world but not so towards the Lord.
ਪਉੜੀ ੨੦
paurree 20
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੂਰਾ ਤੋਲੁ, ਨ ਤੋਲਣਿ ਤੋਲੀਐ ।
guramukh pooraa tol, na tolan toleeai |
Gurmukh is perfect; he cannot be weighed on any scale.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੂਰਾ ਬੋਲੁ, ਨ ਬੋਲਣਿ ਬੋਲੀਐ ।
guramukh pooraa bol, na bolan boleeai |
Every word by gurmukh comes to be true and perfect and nothing can be said about him.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਤਿ ਅਡੋਲ, ਨ ਡੋਲਣਿ ਡੋਲੀਐ ।
guramukh mat addol, na ddolan ddoleeai |
The wisdom of gurmukhs is stable one and does not get destabilised even if done so.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਿਰਮੁ ਅਮੋਲੁ, ਨ ਮੋਲਣਿ ਮੋਲੀਐ ।
guramukh piram amol, na molan moleeai |
The love of gurmukhs is invaluable and it cannot be purchased at any cost.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੰਥੁ ਨਿਰੋਲੁ, ਨ ਰੋਲਣਿ ਰੋਲੀਐ ।
guramukh panth nirol, na rolan roleeai |
The way of gurmukh is clear and distinct; it cannot be subsumed and dissipated by any one.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਲੋਲੁ, ਪੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਝੋਲੀਐ ।੨੦।
guramukh sabad alol, pee amrit jholeeai |20|
The words of gurmukhs are steadfast; along with them one quaffs nectar by deleting passions and carnal desires.
ਪਉੜੀ ੨੧
paurree 21
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਪਾਇ, ਸਭ ਫਲ ਪਾਇਆ ।
guramukh sukh fal paae, sabh fal paaeaa |
By attaining pleasure-fruit gurmukhs have received all the fruits.
ਰੰਗ ਸੁਰੰਗ ਚੜ੍ਹਾਇ, ਸਭ ਰੰਗ ਲਾਇਆ ।
rang surang charrhaae, sabh rang laaeaa |
Putting on the beautiful colour of the Lord they have enjoyed the delight of all the colours.
ਗੰਧ ਸੁਗੰਧਿ ਸਮਾਇ, ਬੋਹਿ ਬੁਹਾਇਆ ।
gandh sugandh samaae, bohi buhaaeaa |
Merging in the fragrance (of devotion) they make everyone fragrant.
ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਇ, ਸਭ ਰਸ ਆਇਆ ।
amrit ras tripataae, sabh ras aaeaa |
They have satiated with the delight of nectar and now they feel as if they have had all the taste.
ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ, ਅਨਹਦ ਵਾਇਆ ।
sabad surat liv laae, anahad vaaeaa |
Merging their consciousness in the Word they have become one with the unstruck melody.
ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਜਾਇ, ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਧਾਇਆ ।੨੧।੧੯। ਉਨੀ ।
nij ghar nihachal jaae, deh dis dhaaeaa |21|19| unee |
Now they get stabilised in their inner self and their mind does not now wonder in all the ten directions.
ਪਉੜੀ ੧
paurree 1
ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਦੇਉ, ਆਪੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ।
satigur naanak deo, aap upaaeaa |
God himself created the true Guru Nanak.
ਗੁਰ ਅੰਗਦੁ ਗੁਰਸਿਖੁ, ਬਬਾਣੇ ਆਇਆ ।
gur angad gurasikh, babaane aaeaa |
Becoming Sikh of the Guru, Guru Angad joined this family.
ਗੁਰਸਿਖੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਅਮਰੁ, ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਇਆ ।
gurasikh hai gur amar, satigur bhaaeaa |
Liked by the true Guru, Guru Amar Das became Sikh of the Guru.
ਰਾਮਦਾਸੁ ਗੁਰਸਿਖੁ, ਗੁਰੁ ਸਦਵਾਇਆ ।
raamadaas gurasikh, gur sadavaaeaa |
Then Ram Das, the Sikh of the Guru came to be known as the Guru.
ਗੁਰੁ ਅਰਜਨੁ ਗੁਰਸਿਖੁ, ਪਰਗਟੀ ਆਇਆ ।
gur arajan gurasikh, paragattee aaeaa |
Thereafter came Guru Arjan as the disciple of the Guru (and got established as the Guru).
ਗੁਰਸਿਖੁ ਹਰਿਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ, ਨ ਲੁਕੈ ਲੁਕਾਇਆ ।੧।
gurasikh harigovind, na lukai lukaaeaa |1|
Hargobind, the Sikh of the Guru cannot remain concealed even if somebody wishes to (and this further means that all the Gurus had the same light).
ਪਉੜੀ ੨
paurree 2
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਰਸੁ ਹੋਇ, ਪੂਜ ਕਰਾਇਆ ।
guramukh paaras hoe, pooj karaaeaa |
The Gurmukh (Guru Nanak) by becoming the philosopher's stone made all the disciples venerable.
ਅਸਟ ਧਾਤੁ ਇਕੁ ਧਾਤੁ, ਜੋਤਿ ਜਗਾਇਆ ।
asatt dhaat ik dhaat, jot jagaaeaa |
He illumined the people of all the varnas as the philosopher's stone converts all the right metals into gold.
ਬਾਵਨ ਚੰਦਨੁ ਹੋਇ, ਬਿਰਖੁ ਬੋਹਾਇਆ ।
baavan chandan hoe, birakh bohaaeaa |
By becoming sandalwood he made all the trees fragrant.
ਗੁਰਸਿਖੁ ਸਿਖੁ ਗੁਰ ਹੋਇ, ਅਚਰਜੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ।
gurasikh sikh gur hoe, acharaj dikhaaeaa |
He accomplished the wonder of making disciple the Guru.
ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਜਗਾਇ, ਦੀਪੁ ਦੀਪਾਇਆ ।
jotee jot jagaae, deep deepaaeaa |
Extended his light similarly as a lamp is lit by another lamp.
ਨੀਰੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਨੀਰੁ, ਮਿਲੈ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ।੨।
neerai andar neer, milai milaaeaa |2|
As the water mixing with water becomes one, likewise deleting ego, the Sikh merges into the Guru.
ਪਉੜੀ ੩
paurree 3
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ ਜਨਮੁ, ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ।
guramukh sukh fal janam, satigur paaeaa |
The life of that Gurmukh is successful who has met the true Guru.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੂਰ ਕਰੰਮੁ, ਸਰਣੀ ਆਇਆ ।
guramukh poor karam, saranee aaeaa |
The Gurmukh who has surrendered before the Guru is a blest one and his fate is perfect one.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਾਇ, ਨਾਉ ਦਿੜਾਇਆ ।
satigur pairee paae, naau dirraaeaa |
The true Guru, by giving him place around his feet has made him remember the name (of the Lord).
ਘਰ ਹੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਉਦਾਸੁ, ਨ ਵਿਆਪੈ ਮਾਇਆ ।
ghar hee vich udaas, na viaapai maaeaa |
Now being detached, he remains at home and maya does not affect him.
ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਕਮਾਇ, ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਆ ।
gur upades kamaae, alakh lakhaaeaa |
By putting into practice the teachings of the Guru, he has realised he invisible Lord.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤੁ, ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ।੩।
guramukh jeevan mukat, aap gavaaeaa |3|
Losing his ego, the Guru-orientated Gurmukh has become liberated though still embodied.
ਪਉੜੀ ੪
paurree 4
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ, ਨ ਆਪੁ ਗਣਾਇਆ ।
guramukh aap gavaae, na aap ganaaeaa |
The Gurmukhs erase their ego and never allow themselves to be noticed.
ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਮਿਟਾਇ, ਇਕੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ।
doojaa bhaau mittaae, ik dhiaaeaa |
Effacing duality, they venerate only one Lord.
ਗੁਰ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਜਾਣਿ, ਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਇਆ ।
gur paramesar jaan, sabad kamaaeaa |
Accepting Guru as God they by cultivating the words of the Guru, translate them into life.
ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਚਲਿ ਜਾਇ, ਸੀਸੁ ਨਿਵਾਇਆ ।
saadhasangat chal jaae, sees nivaaeaa |
The Gurmukhs serve and attain the fruits of happiness.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ, ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ।
guramukh kaar kamaae, sukh fal paaeaa |
This way receiving the cup of love,
ਪਿਰਮ ਪਿਆਲਾ ਪਾਇ, ਅਜਰੁ ਜਰਾਇਆ ।੪।
piram piaalaa paae, ajar jaraaeaa |4|
They bear the effect of this unbearable in their mind.
ਪਉੜੀ ੫
paurree 5
ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਵੇਲੇ ਉਠਿ, ਜਾਗ ਜਗਾਇਆ ।
amrit vele utth, jaag jagaaeaa |
The Guru-orientated gets up early in the morning and makes others also to do so.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਨਾਇ, ਭਰਮ ਗਵਾਇਆ ।
guramukh teerath naae, bharam gavaaeaa |
Discarding delusions is equal to bathing at the holy places for him.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੰਤੁ ਸਮ੍ਹਾਲਿ, ਜਪੁ ਜਪਾਇਆ ।
guramukh mant samhaal, jap japaaeaa |
Gurmukh carefully and attentively recites the moolmantar.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਹੋਇ, ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ।
guramukh nihachal hoe, ik man dhiaaeaa |
The Gurmukh single-mindedly concentrates upon the Lord.
ਮਥੈ ਟਿਕਾ ਲਾਲੁ, ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ਸੁਹਾਇਆ ।
mathai ttikaa laal, neesaan suhaaeaa |
The red mark of love adorns his forehead.
ਪੈਰੀ ਪੈ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ, ਪੈਰੀ ਪਾਇਆ ।੫।
pairee pai gurasikh, pairee paaeaa |5|
Falling on the feet of the Sikhs of the Guru and thus through his own humility, he makes others surrender to his feet.
ਪਉੜੀ ੬

Touching the feet, the Sikhs of the Guru wash their feet.
ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਵਾਣੀ ਚਖਿ, ਮਨੁ ਵਸਿ ਆਇਆ ।
amrit vaanee chakh, man vas aaeaa |
Then they taste the ambrosial word (of Guru) through which the mind is controlled.
ਪਾਣੀ ਪਖਾ ਪੀਹਿ, ਭਠੁ ਝੁਕਾਇਆ ।
paanee pakhaa peehi, bhatth jhukaaeaa |
They fetch water, fan the sangat and put wood in the firebox of the kitchen.
ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਸੁਣਿ ਸਿਖਿ, ਲਿਖਿ ਲਿਖਾਇਆ ।
gurabaanee sun sikh, likh likhaaeaa |
They listen to, write and make others write the hymns of the Gurus.
ਨਾਮੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ, ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇਆ ।
naam daan isanaan, karam kamaaeaa |
They practice the remembrance of Lords name, charity and ablutions.
ਨਿਵ ਚਲਣੁ ਮਿਠ ਬੋਲ, ਘਾਲਿ ਖਵਾਇਆ ।੬।
niv chalan mitth bol, ghaal khavaaeaa |6|
They walk in humility, speak sweetly, and eat the earning of their own hands.
ਪਉੜੀ ੭
paurree 7

gurasikhaan gurasikh, mel milaaeaa |
The Sikhs of Guru meet the Sikhs of the Guru.
ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਗੁਰਪੁਰਬ, ਕਰੈ ਕਰਾਇਆ ।
bhaae bhagat gurapurab, karai karaaeaa |
Bound by the loving devotion, they celebrate the anniversaries of the Guru.
ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਦੇਵੀ ਦੇਵ, ਜਠੇਰੇ ਭਾਇਆ ।
gurasikh devee dev, jatthere bhaaeaa |
For them, the Sikh of the Guru is the god, goddess and the father.
ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਮਾਂ ਪਿਉ ਵੀਰ, ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸਬਾਇਆ ।
gurasikh maan piau veer, kuttanb sabaaeaa |
Mother, father, brother and the family also is the Sikh of the Guru.
ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਖੇਤੀ ਵਣਜੁ, ਲਾਹਾ ਪਾਇਆ ।

Meeting to the Sikhs of the Guru is farming business as well as other gainful occupations for the Sikh.

The progeny of the swan like Sikhs of Guru is also the Sikh of the Guru.
ਪਉੜੀ ੮
paurree 8
ਸਜਾ ਖਬਾ ਸਉਣੁ, ਨ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ।
sajaa khabaa saun, na man vasaaeaa |
The Gurmukhs never take to their heart the omen on the right or the left.
ਨਾਰਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਨੋ ਵੇਖਿ, ਨ ਪੈਰੁ ਹਟਾਇਆ ।
naar purakh no vekh, na pair hattaaeaa |
They do not retrace their steps while seeing a man or woman.
ਭਾਖ ਸੁਭਾਖ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ, ਨ ਛਿਕ ਮਨਾਇਆ ।
bhaakh subhaakh veechaar, na chhik manaaeaa |
They do not pay attention to the crises of animals or sneezing.
ਦੇਵੀ ਦੇਵ ਨ ਸੇਵਿ; ਨ ਪੂਜ ਕਰਾਇਆ ।
devee dev na sev; na pooj karaaeaa |
Goddess and gods are neither served nor worshipped by them.
ਭੰਭਲਭੂਸੇ ਖਾਇ, ਨ ਮਨੁ ਭਰਮਾਇਆ ।
bhanbhalabhoose khaae, na man bharamaaeaa |
By not entangling in deceits, they do not allow their minds to wander.
ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਸਚਾ ਖੇਤੁ, ਬੀਜ ਫਲਾਇਆ ।੮।
gurasikh sachaa khet, beej falaaeaa |8|
The Gursikhs have sowed the seed of truth in the field of life and have made it fruitful.
ਪਉੜੀ ੯
paurree 9
ਕਿਰਤਿ ਵਿਰਤਿ ਮਨੁ ਧਰਮੁ, ਸਚੁ ਦਿੜਾਇਆ ।
kirat virat man dharam, sach dirraaeaa |
For earning livelihood, the Gurmukhs keep in mind, the dharma and always remember the truth.
ਸਚੁ ਨਾਉ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ, ਆਪੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ।
sach naau karataar, aap upaaeaa |
They know that the creator himself has created (and diffused) the truth.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ, ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਆਇਆ ।
satigur purakh deaal, deaa kar aaeaa |
That true Guru, the supreme one, compassionately has descended on earth.
ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਆਕਾਰੁ, ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ ।
nirankaar aakaar, sabad sunaaeaa |
Personifying the formless into the form of Word He has recited it for one and all.
ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਚੁ ਖੰਡ, ਥੇਹੁ ਵਸਾਇਆ ।
saadhasangat sach khandd, thehu vasaaeaa |
The Guru has founded the high mound of the holy congregation known also as the abode of truth.
ਸਚਾ ਤਖਤੁ ਬਣਾਇ, ਸਲਾਮੁ ਕਰਾਇਆ ।੯।
sachaa takhat banaae, salaam karaaeaa |9|
There only establishing the true throne he has made all to bow and salute.
ਪਉੜੀ ੧੦
paurree 10
ਗੁਰਸਿਖਾ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ, ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਇਆ ।
gurasikhaa gurasikh, sevaa laaeaa |
The Sikhs of the Guru inspire the Sikhs of the Guru to serve.
ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਸੇਵ, ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ।
saadhasangat kar sev, sukh fal paaeaa |
Serving the holy congregation they receive the fruit of happiness.
ਤਪੜੁ ਝਾੜਿ ਵਿਛਾਇ, ਧੂੜੀ ਨਾਇਆ ।
taparr jhaarr vichhaae, dhoorree naaeaa |
Sweeping and spreading the sitting mats they bathe in the dust of the holy congregation.
ਕੋਰੇ ਮਟ ਅਣਾਇ, ਨੀਰੁ ਭਰਾਇਆ ।
kore matt anaae, neer bharaaeaa |
They bring unused pitchers and fill them with water (to get it cold).
ਆਣਿ ਮਹਾ ਪਰਸਾਦੁ, ਵੰਡਿ ਖੁਆਇਆ ।੧੦।
aan mahaa parasaad, vandd khuaaeaa |10|
They bring sacred food (maha parshad), distribute it among others and eat.
ਪਉੜੀ ੧੧
paurree 11
ਹੋਇ ਬਿਰਖੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ, ਸਿਰ ਤਲਵਾਇਆ ।

ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ, ਸੀਸੁ ਨਿਵਾਇਆ ।
nihachal hoe nivaas, sees nivaaeaa |
It stands steadfast and maintains its head low.
ਹੋਇ ਸੁਫਲ ਫਲੁ ਸਫਲੁ, ਵਟ ਸਹਾਇਆ ।
hoe sufal fal safal, vatt sahaaeaa |
Then becoming full of fruits it bears the stone-blows.
ਸਿਰਿ ਕਰਵਤੁ ਧਰਾਇ, ਜਹਾਜੁ ਬਣਾਇਆ ।
sir karavat dharaae, jahaaj banaaeaa |
Further it gets sawed and causes to make ship.
ਪਾਣੀ ਦੇ ਸਿਰਿ ਵਾਟ, ਰਾਹੁ ਚਲਾਇਆ ।
paanee de sir vaatt, raahu chalaaeaa |
Now it moves on the head of water.
ਸਿਰਿ ਕਰਵਤੁ ਧਰਾਇ, ਸੀਸ ਚੜਾਇਆ ।੧੧।
sir karavat dharaae, sees charraaeaa |11|

ਪਉੜੀ ੧੨

ਲੋਹਾ ਸੀਸੁ ਚੜਾਇ, ਨੀਰਿ ਤਰਾਇਆ ।
lohaa sees charraae, neer taraaeaa |
But the tree carry iron on its head keeps it floating on water.
ਆਪਨੜਾ ਪੁਤੁ ਪਾਲਿ, ਨ ਨੀਰਿ ਡੁਬਾਇਆ ।

Nobody can know its extent. That creator is without any anxiety;how could He be persuaded and amused.
ਕੇਵਡੁ ਹੈ ਦਰਗਾਹ, ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਈਐ ।
kevadd hai daragaah, aakh sunaaeeai |
How the majesty of His court could be described.
ਕੋਇ ਨ ਦਸੈ ਰਾਹੁ, ਕਿਤੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਈਐ ।
koe na dasai raahu, kit bidh jaaeeai |
None is there to tell the way and means leading to Him.
ਕੇਵਡੁ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਲਾਹ, ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ।
kevadd sifat salaah, kiau kar dhiaaeeai |
This is also incomprehensible that how infinite are his eulogies and how should He be concentrated upon.
ਅਬਿਗਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਅਸਗਾਹੁ, ਨ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਈਐ ।੧੯।
abigat gat asagaahu, na alakh lakhaaeeai |19|
The dynamics of the Lord is unmanifest, deep and unfathomable; it cannot be known.
ਪਉੜੀ ੨੦
paurree 20
ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਪਰਮਾਦਿ, ਅਚਰਜੁ ਆਖੀਐ ।
aad purakh paramaad, acharaj aakheeai |
The primeval Lord is said to be the supreme wonder.
ਆਦਿ ਅਨੀਲੁ ਅਨਾਦਿ, ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਸਾਖੀਐ ।
aad aneel anaad, sabad na saakheeai |
The words also fail to tell about the beginning of that beginningless.
ਵਰਤੈ ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ, ਨ ਗਲੀ ਗਾਖੀਐ ।
varatai aad jugaad, na galee gaakheeai |
He operates in the time and even before the time primordial and mere discussions cannot explain Him.
ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਅਛਲਾਦਿ, ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਖੀਐ ।
bhagat vachhal achhalaad, sehaj subhaakheeai |
He, the protector and lover of the devotees is undeceivable known by the name of the equipoise.
ਉਨਮਨਿ ਅਨਹਦਿ ਨਾਦਿ, ਲਿਵ ਅਭਿਲਾਖੀਐ ।
aunaman anahad naad, liv abhilaakheeai |
The desire of the consciousness is to remain merged in His unstruck melody heard in the trance.
ਵਿਸਮਾਦੈ ਵਿਸਮਾਦ, ਪੂਰਨ ਪਾਖੀਐ ।
visamaadai visamaad, pooran paakheeai |
He, being full of all dimensions, is the wonder of the wonders.
ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ, ਕੇਵਲ ਕਾਖੀਐ ।੨੦।੨੧। ਇਕੀਹ ।
poorai gur parasaad, keval kaakheeai |20|21| ikeeh |
Now the only desire remains that the grace of the perfect Guru be with me (so that I may realise the Lord).
ਪਉੜੀ ੧
paurree 1
ਨਿਰਾਧਾਰ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ, ਨ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਆ ।
niraadhaar nirankaar, na alakh lakhaaeaa |
The formless Lord who is without any anchor and is imperceptible, has not made himself fully known to anyone.
ਹੋਆ ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ, ਆਪੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ।
hoaa ekankaar, aap upaaeaa |
From unembodiment He assumed the form by himself and becoming Oankar
ਓਅੰਕਾਰਿ ਅਕਾਰੁ, ਚਲਿਤੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ।
oankaar akaar, chalit rachaaeaa |
He created infinite wondrous forms.
ਸਚੁ ਨਾਉ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ, ਬਿਰਦੁ ਸਦਾਇਆ ।
sach naau karataar, birad sadaaeaa |
In the form of the true name (ndm) and becoming the creator, He came to be known as the protector of His own reputation.
ਸਚਾ ਪਰਵਦਗਾਰੁ, ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਮਾਇਆ ।
sachaa paravadagaar, trai gun maaeaa |
Through three dimensional maya He nourishes one and all.
ਸਿਰਠੀ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੁ, ਲੇਖੁ ਲਿਖਾਇਆ ।
siratthee sirajanahaar, lekh likhaaeaa |
He is the creator of the cosmos and prescribes its destiny.
ਸਭਸੈ ਦੇ ਆਧਾਰੁ, ਨ ਤੋਲਿ ਤੁਲਾਇਆ ।
sabhasai de aadhaar, na tol tulaaeaa |
He is the basis of all, the incomparable One.
ਲਖਿਆ ਥਿਤਿ ਨ ਵਾਰੁ, ਨ ਮਾਹੁ ਜਣਾਇਆ ।
lakhiaa thit na vaar, na maahu janaaeaa |
None has ever disclosed the date, the day and month (of creation).
ਵੇਦ ਕਤੇਬ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ, ਨ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ ।੧।
ved kateb veechaar, na aakh sunaaeaa |1|
Even the Vedas and other scriptures could not fully explain His thoughts.
ਪਉੜੀ ੨
paurree 2
ਨਿਰਾਲੰਬੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੁ, ਬਾਣੁ ਚਲਾਇਆ ।
niraalanb nirabaan, baan chalaaeaa |
Who without any props, and uncontrolled by habit has created behavioural patterns?
ਉਡੈ ਹੰਸ ਉਚਾਣ, ਕਿਨਿ ਪਹੁਚਾਇਆ ।
auddai hans uchaan, kin pahuchaaeaa |
How the swan reaches the heights of sky?
ਖੰਭੀ ਚੋਜ ਵਿਡਾਣੁ, ਆਣਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ।
khanbhee choj viddaan, aan milaaeaa |
Wondrous is the mystery of wings which made the swan to soar at such heights.
ਧ੍ਰੂ ਚੜਿਆ ਅਸਮਾਣਿ, ਨ ਟਲੈ ਟਲਾਇਆ ।
dhraoo charriaa asamaan, na ttalai ttalaaeaa |
How did Dhruv in the form of immovable star mount the sky?
ਮਿਲੈ ਨਿਮਾਣੈ ਮਾਣੁ, ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ।
milai nimaanai maan, aap gavaaeaa |
It is a mystery how a humble eschewing ego acquires honour in life.
ਦਰਗਹ ਪਤਿ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ, ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ।੨।
daragah pat paravaan, guramukh dhiaaeaa |2|
Only the gurmukh who has meditated upon Lord is accepted in His court.
ਪਉੜੀ ੩
paurree 3
ਓੜਕੁ ਓੜਕੁ ਭਾਲਿ, ਨ ਓੜਕੁ ਪਾਇਆ ।
orrak orrak bhaal, na orrak paaeaa |
In order to know Him, people put in extreme efforts but could not know His extant.
ਓੜਕੁ ਭਾਲਣਿ ਗਏ, ਸਿ ਫੇਰ ਨ ਆਇਆ ।
orrak bhaalan ge, si fer na aaeaa |
Those who went out to know His bounds could never return.
ਓੜਕੁ ਲਖ ਕਰੋੜਿ, ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ।
orrak lakh karorr, bharam bhulaaeaa |
To know Him, myriads of people have remained wandering in illusions.
ਆਦੁ ਵਡਾ ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ, ਨ ਅੰਤੁ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ ।
aad vaddaa visamaad, na ant sunaaeaa |
That primeval Lord is the grand wonder whose mystery cannot be understood by mere listening.
ਹਾਥਿ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ, ਲਹਰੀ ਛਾਇਆ ।
haath na paaraavaar, laharee chhaaeaa |
His waves, shades etc are limitless.
ਇਕੁ ਕਵਾਉ ਪਸਾਉ, ਨ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਆ ।
eik kavaau pasaau, na alakh lakhaaeaa |
The imperceptible Lord who has created all through His single vibration cannot be perceived.
ਕਾਦਰੁ ਨੋ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ, ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਮਾਇਆ ।
kaadar no kurabaan, kudarat maaeaa |
I am sacrifice unto that creator, whose maya is this creation.
ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਆਪੁ, ਗੁਰਿ ਸਮਝਾਇਆ ।੩।
aape jaanai aap, gur samajhaaeaa |3|
The Guru has made me understand that God alone knows about His own self (none else can know Him).
ਪਉੜੀ ੪
paurree 4
ਸਚਾ ਸਿਰਜਣਿਹਾਰੁ, ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ।
sachaa sirajanihaar, sach samaaeaa |
The true Creator as the Truth is pervading one and all.
ਸਚਹੁ ਪਉਣੁ ਉਪਾਇ, ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਛਾਇਆ ।
sachahu paun upaae, ghatt ghatt chhaaeaa |
Out of Truth He created air and (in the form of vital air) is residing in all
ਪਵਣਹੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਸਾਜਿ, ਸੀਸੁ ਨਿਵਾਇਆ ।
pavanahu paanee saaj, sees nivaaeaa |
From air was created water which always remains humble i.e. it. always moves down wards.
ਤੁਲਹਾ ਧਰਤਿ ਬਣਾਇ, ਨੀਰ ਤਰਾਇਆ ।
tulahaa dharat banaae, neer taraaeaa |
Earth as a raft is made to float on water.
ਨੀਰਹੁ ਉਪਜੀ ਅਗਿ, ਵਣਖੰਡੁ ਛਾਇਆ ।
neerahu upajee ag, vanakhandd chhaaeaa |
From water emerged fire which spread throughout the whole vegetation.
ਅਗੀ ਹੋਦੀ ਬਿਰਖੁ, ਸੁਫਲ ਫਲਾਇਆ ।
agee hodee birakh, sufal falaaeaa |
By virtue of this very fire (heat) the trees became. full of fruits
ਪਉਣੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਬੈਸੰਤਰੁ, ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ।
paun paanee baisantar, mel milaaeaa |
In this way, air, water and fire were integrated under the order of that primaeval Lord
ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਆਦੇਸੁ, ਖੇਲੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ।੪।
aad purakh aades, khel rachaaeaa |4|
And thus was this game of creation arranged.
